2609.31235.title: Purin: A Biology-inspired Mechanism for Artificial Neural Networks
2609.31235.paper_summary: Artificial neural networks (ANNs) usually represent neural transmission with fixed trainable weights during a training batch, which omits short-term changes in synaptic efficacy. In addition, the discrete time-step simulation requires additional temporal processing that many conventional ANN architectures do not use. To overcome these challenges, we propose Purin, a biology-inspired and ANN-compatible mechanism, that introduces synaptic efficacy modulation into conventional convolutional neural networks. Purin uses a time-interval-based abstraction for neural activities, which allows Purin to introduce short- and long-term synaptic efficacy changes without using discrete time-steps. Purin introduces a bounded factor to represent temporary synaptic efficacy changes, together with two weight matrices that represent input-side and output-side efficacy. The weight matrices are updated by backpropagation and interpreted as the long-term synaptic efficacy changes. Experimental results show that after removing the confounding factors in the AlexNet, VGG11, and GoogLeNet architectures, Purin improves the classification accuracies in all three models across the evaluated datasets.
2609.31235.paper_summary_zh: 人工神經網絡（ANNs）通常在訓練批次中以固定的可訓練權重來表示神經傳遞，這忽略了突觸效能的短期變化。<lb/>此外，離散時間步模擬需要額外的時間處理，而許多傳統的ANN架構並未使用。<lb/>為了克服這些挑戰，我們提出了Purin，一種受生物啟發且與ANN兼容的機制，將突觸效能調節引入傳統的卷積神經網絡中。<lb/>Purin使用基於時間間隔的抽象來表示神經活動，這使Purin能夠在不使用離散時間步的情況下引入短期和長期的突觸效能變化。<lb/>Purin引入了一個有界因子來表示暫時的突觸效能變化，並配備兩個權重矩陣，分別表示輸入端和輸出端的效能。<lb/>這些權重矩陣通過反向傳播進行更新，並被解釋為長期的突觸效能變化。<lb/>實驗結果顯示，在去除AlexNet、VGG11和GoogLeNet架構中的混淆因素後，Purin在所有三個模型的評估數據集上提高了分類準確率。
